verdict.rationale: Gitleaks lets users write their own detection rules, including composite and allowlist rules, in a gitleaks.toml config. Events can trigger automatic actions: a pre-commit hook blocks commits containing secrets, and gitleaks-action scans PRs and commits, comments on PRs and alerts listed accounts. However, the rules only define what counts as a secret; the resulting actions are fixed (fail, comment, notify) rather than user-defined event→action automations. Missing for 10: a general user-configurable rule→action engine, custom actions beyond fail/comment/alert, event types beyond commits and PRs, independent corroboration.
